content.title: PENGU is the official coin of Pudgy Penguins.
content.description: Pudgy Penguins has become the face of crypto with one of the most influential communities in the industry. From large companies wearing the Penguin, to being featured in ETF commercials, to garnering millions of followers and over 100 billion views, the Pengu has become a cultural icon making PENGU the world’s social currency.

content.title: About Nockchain (NOCK)
content.description: Nockchain is a Layer 1 blockchain that utilizes zero-knowledge proofs within a Proof of Work consensus framework to secure a decentralized market for verifiable computation.

content.title: What is pump.fun?
content.description: Pump.fun is a Solana-based memecoin generator/launchpad that simplifies the process of creating tokens, allowing users to launch their own memecoins without needing technical expertise.

content.title: What is Lisk (LSK)?
content.description: Lisk is the modern money operations platform for businesses. Finance and operations teams use Lisk to run accounts, payments, and approvals in one workspace, moving money across fiat and stablecoin rails. Lisk is built for companies that operate across borders, entities, and currencies, replacing the patchwork of tools they use today with a single platform for everyday business finance. LSK is Lisk's loyalty token. It lives on Base and Ethereum, with Base as its primary Layer 2 network. Over time, businesses will earn rewards for running their money operations on Lisk and for referring other companies, with additional LSK utility rolling out in phases. Live since 2016, Lisk is one of the longest-running projects in the industry. Today that experience goes into a focused mission: making business finance work the way modern companies do.

content.title: About Solana (SOL)
content.description: Solana is a high-performance Layer 1 blockchain built for mass adoption, offering a fast and low-cost environment for decentralized applications.

content.title: Illuvium (ILV) TL;DR
content.description: Illuvium is a decentralized franchise of interconnected, high-quality games built on the Ethereum network that allows players to own their in-game assets as non-fungible tokens.

content.title: What is UNI?
content.description: UNI is the governance token for Uniswap. UNI was introduced on 16th September 2020 through a retrospective airdrop to users who have interacted with the protocol either by swapping tokens or by providing liquidity.

content.title: What is Hyperliquid about?
content.description: Hyperliquid is a layer one (L1) blockchain best known for perpetual futures and spot trading. Beyond its flagship DEX trading platform, the ecosystem supports borrowing, lending, real world assets (RWAs), and a full-fledged Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM), making it a leading force in decentralized finance (defi).

content.title: What is Pepe about?
content.description: PEPE is a community-driven meme token inspired by the internet character Pepe the Frog, a well-known figure in online meme culture. Launched in April 2023, the project aims to embrace the lighthearted and humorous side of cryptocurrency by creating a token centered around internet culture and community engagement. Rather than focusing on complex use cases or utility, PEPE is built around the idea of shared fun and cultural relevance.

content.title: About Ethereum
content.description: Ethereum is a blockchain platform that enables developers to build and deploy smart contracts and decentralized applications, operating through thousands of independent nodes worldwide rather than through a central authority.

content.title: What is NEAR Protocol?
content.description: NEAR Protocol is the blockchain for AI. A high-performance, AI-native platform built to power the next generation of decentralized applications and intelligent agents. It provides the infrastructure AI needs to transact, operate, and interact across Web2 and Web3. NEAR combines three core elements: User-Owned AI, which ensures agents act in users’ best interests; Intents and Chain Abstraction, which eliminate blockchain complexity for seamless, goal-driven transactions across chains; and a sharded blockchain architecture that delivers the scalability, speed, and low-cost execution needed for real-world AI and Web3 use. This integrated stack makes NEAR the foundation for building secure, user-owned, AI-native applications at internet scale.
